members.identification: Universal Mach-O launcher carrying an AMOS-style AppleScript credential stealer
members.marker: Installer stealer: phishes and uploads secrets; refine traits
evidence: x86-64 entry 0x100000630 constructs a string and calls system at 0x10000065c; ARM64 entry calls system at 0x1000006b8.
Both slices contain the identical 37084-byte encrypted structure. Data starts after its 4-byte seed at file offsets 0x4c90 and 0x14de0.
Decoder XORs 37077 bytes with the low state byte. Initial state is 0x11667; next state is uint32(state*0x3785) modulo 35999, derived from the embedded build-time string 09:59:59.
Recovered command constructs and executes AppleScript through osascript -e and run script. Numeric handler and variable names obscure relationships.
Main handler checks ~/.pwd with dscl authonly; failing that, an Installation dialog captures a hidden device-password answer until it validates. Password is saved and included in collection.
Reachable helpers copy Chromium/Firefox credentials, cookies, wallet extension stores, desktop wallets, login.keychain-db, Notes and selected Desktop/Documents files to a random /tmp directory.
ditto compresses staging to /tmp/out.zip, then curl POSTs that file to the configured host with campaign/user headers; staging and archive are removed.
An installed Ledger Live bundle triggers download of a replacement ZIP, process termination, sudo removal and unzip into /Applications.

Another handler downloads shell command text for a KeepAlive/RunAtLoad system LaunchDaemon, installs and bootstraps it with the captured password. The plist UserName selects the current user, so root execution is not established.
members.context_limit: No deployment history is supplied. Credential phishing, broad secret collection, export and trusted-app replacement establish the verdict without needing the downstream server payload.

members.marker: shared 0.2.0: MongoDB object store, bundled tests and empty DLLs
evidence: Listed tar members, examined package manifest, README, TypeScript sources, generated JavaScript, bundled Promise implementation, test launchers and presentation plugin.
The named tarball is absent from the supplied ZIP; recovered https://registry.npmjs.org/shared/-/shared-0.2.0.tgz and verified its exact requested SHA-256 before analysis.

Main module exports createStore; it constructs MongoStore using caller options, defaulting to localhost:27017. apply queues the callback, loads root state, tracks mutations and commits through the configured MongoDB collection.
Module initialization imports its declared dependencies and defines helpers. Serialization, object tracking, database locking and retry timers implement its stated purpose.
Mocha wrapper spawns the local _mocha runner with the current Node image and passed flags; Jade prepublish executes npm prune. These are vendored testing/build functions, not secret collection.
The reveal.js postMessage plugin dispatches slideshow methods through Reveal[method].apply; this is presentation control, not an OS-command channel.
Parsed all seven bundled .NET DLLs with dnfile: each contains only the <Module> type and zero MethodDef rows. They are empty Visual Studio build artifacts.
